title: Delinquency, Default and Reinstatement Terms of the Patient Payment Plan Tiers
content:
Patient Accounts holds the following figures for a Patient Payment Plan that falls behind: when a default notice is sent, how long the notice runs, what happens to the balance on default, whether and for how long a defaulted plan may be reinstated, and whether enrolled charges are shielded from collections.

## Default

| Tier | Consecutive missed installments after which a default notice is sent | Calendar days after the default notice before the plan defaults | Remaining balance returns to the statement and collections cycle of its plan of care on default |
|---|---|---|---|
| Short-Term 3-Month Payment Plan | 2 | 10 | Yes |
| Standard 6-Month Payment Plan | 2 | 10 | Yes |
| Extended 10-Month Payment Plan | 2 | 10 | Yes |
| Long-Term 12-Month Payment Plan | 3 | 10 | Yes |
| Large-Balance 18-Month Payment Plan | 3 | 10 | Yes |
| Hardship 24-Month Payment Plan | 3 | 15 | Yes |

## Reinstatement and collections protection

| Tier | Reinstatement of a defaulted plan allowed | Reinstatement window (calendar days after the default date) | Most reinstatements of one plan | Charges in an active or past-due plan never transferred to collections |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Short-Term 3-Month Payment Plan | No | 0 | 0 | Yes |
| Standard 6-Month Payment Plan | Yes | 30 | 1 | Yes |
| Extended 10-Month Payment Plan | Yes | 30 | 1 | Yes |
| Long-Term 12-Month Payment Plan | Yes | 30 | 1 | Yes |
| Large-Balance 18-Month Payment Plan | Yes | 30 | 1 | Yes |
| Hardship 24-Month Payment Plan | Yes | 45 | 2 | Yes |

## Questions answered by the table

- **Which tier cannot be reinstated after default?** The Short-Term 3-Month Payment Plan: reinstatement is not allowed, its window is 0 days and its limit is 0.
- **Which tiers send the default notice after the second consecutive missed installment?** The Short-Term, Standard and Extended tiers; the Long-Term, Large-Balance and Hardship tiers send it after the third.
- **Is any tier without collections protection?** No. On all six tiers, charges in a plan that is active or past due are never transferred to collections.
